name: Name
payoutDescription: Used when the treasurer pays out approved expenses you covered with your own money.
fortnoxSubtitle: Your personal login. Vouchers you export are booked in your name.
fortnoxRequired: Required to export vouchers to Fortnox.
fortnoxSignOutFailed: Could not sign out of Fortnox.
signOutNote: Signing out only ends this app's access to your Fortnox account. The session expires on its own after a few hours.

notifications.title: Email
notifications.subtitle: Which emails you get at {email}. Changes are saved straight away.
notifications.digestNote: Every Sunday you also get a summary of what is waiting for you: card transactions without an expense, your own expenses close to the filing deadline, and expenses to attest. It is only sent when there is something in it.

hint.EXPENSE_SUBMITTED: When someone submits an expense for you to attest.
hint.EXPENSE_CHANGES_REQUESTED: When an expense you submitted comes back for changes.
hint.EXPENSE_DEADLINE_WAIVER_REVOKED: When the exemption from the filing deadline is removed from your expense.
hint.CARD_TRANSACTIONS_IMPORTED: When new purchases or refunds on your section card are imported.
hint.EXPENSE_COST_CENTER_APPROVED: When part of your expense is attested and the rest is still waiting.
hint.EXPENSE_APPROVED: When all of your expense is attested.
hint.EXPENSE_ATTEST_WITHDRAWN: When someone withdraws their attest on your expense.
hint.EXPENSE_DEADLINE_WAIVED: When your late expense is granted an exemption from the filing deadline.
hint.EXPENSE_EXPORTED: When your expense is booked and sent to Fortnox.
hint.EXPENSE_RECALLED: When someone recalls an expense that was waiting for your attest.
hint.EXPENSE_READY_TO_BOOK: When an expense is attested and waiting to be booked.
hint.EXPENSE_EXPORT_REVERTED: When someone marks an expense as not exported.
hint.SUPPLIER_INVOICE_ASSIGNED: When a supplier invoice is given to a unit you answer for, or comes back from attest.
hint.SUPPLIER_INVOICE_SUBMITTED: When a supplier invoice you are to attest is sent for attest.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.hint: Drag to move the picture and zoom with the slider. What shows in the circle becomes your picture.
avatar.cannotPreview: Your browser cannot show this picture, so it cannot be cropped here. If you upload it anyway, the middle of the picture is used.
avatar.saveFailed: Could not save the profile picture
avatar.removeFailed: Could not remove the profile picture
